content.text: No non-compete, field-of-use, or territory restriction binding us exists anywhere in the agreement.

input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete, field-of-use, or territory restriction on Customer, which matches the preferred position. § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) is mutual and expressly confirms each party may enter into similar agreements with others, so it does not restrain the businesses we operate or the products we buy or build. The only Customer-side prohibitions are (i) § 14.11 No Resale (a standard restriction on reselling IBM's Services, not on our own business or competing products) and (ii) § 12.1 / § 14.17 license-scope limits (Base Components licensed solely in connection with the Services, no implied licenses), which are ordinary licence-grant boundaries rather than restrictive covenants. § 14.19 Geographic Scope limits IBM's delivery obligations to the United States and imposes no territorial restriction on us. Searches for "compet", "exclusiv", "restrict", "similar services", "engage in" and "Customer shall not" surfaced nothing binding us to a non-compete. No redline required.
